title: Putiphar
summary: Raleigh names Putiphar in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Undated in this intake: no yeere of the World was taken from the covered text except where a chronology entry quotes one. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

birth.citation: BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Chapter 2, Uncovering Subtle Clues in the Narrative
birth.note: He spells the officer Potiphar. Entered on the existing Putiphar record. Saris is that man’s title, not another person. The wife is not named.

free_source_links.locator: Book I, Part I, Chapter III, §. XIV, sig. 73b–74a
